source_title: TOYO Confirms U.S. Customs and Border Protection Release of Ethiopia-Produced Solar Cells - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
TOKYO , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TOYO Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: TOYO ) (OTC: TOYWF) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today announced that U.S. Customs and Border Protection ("CBP") has released shipments of solar cells produced at the Company's facility in Ethiopia, following CBP's review of the supply chain documentation TOYO submitted.
As part of the review, TOYO provided CBP with full traceability documentation for its supply chain, including polysilicon and wafer sourcing. TOYO cooperated fully with CBP throughout the process and thanks the agency for its thorough and professional review.
TOYO has also strengthened its U.S. import compliance program, which supports the Company's U.S. manufacturing operations at its facility in Humble, Texas. The Company is pursuing certification under CBP's Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (CTPAT) program.
"We are grateful to CBP for its careful review," said Takahiko Onozuka, Chief Executive Officer of TOYO. "As a Japanese company building in America, we hold ourselves to the highest standards of transparency and compliance. Our customers need confidence in where their solar products come from, and we intend to lead by example by providing that confidence across our entire supply chain."
TOYO is a solar manufacturing company that is committed to becoming a vertically integrated solar manufacturer in the global market, integrating the upstream production of wafers and silicon, midstream production of solar cells, downstream production of photovoltaic modules, and potentially other stages of the solar power supply chain. TOYO is well-positioned to produce high-quality solar cells and modules at a competitive scale and cost.
